verdict.rationale: x402 is governed by the vendor-neutral x402 Foundation under the Linux Foundation, which has forty member organizations and a multi-company governing board. At least two independent parties implement it: httpay.xyz runs 124 x402 endpoints and Apiosk built an x402 payment-enforcing gateway. Further signals are AWS AgentCore integration, Cloudflare-proposed payment schemes and a Foundation-published npm SDK. Missing for 10: evidence of independent non-Coinbase facilitator or SDK implementations (the documented third-party uses are sellers or gateways, likely relying on the CDP facilitator), and independent corroboration that Foundation members actually ship implementations rather than just holding membership.
